title: Water Shortage Crisis in Gokuldham
description: Gokuldham Society faces a major water pipeline breakdown, leading to hilarious morning chaos among Jethalal, Bhide, Sodhi, and Popatlal.

title: Gulabo Marriage Case in Kutch
description: A woman named Gulabo arrives in Gokuldham claiming she is Jethalal's lawfully wedded wife from a film shooting in Kutch!

title: Champaklal's Unstoppable Hiccups
description: Bapuji suffers from non-stop hiccups that won't go away, prompting the entire Gokuldham society to try hilarious remedies.

title: Gokuldham Premier League (GPL 1)
tagline: Jetha Ke Janbaaz vs Daya Ke Daredevils
description: The iconic cricket tournament in Gokuldham Society pitting Jethalal's team against Daya's team for ultimate bragging rights.

title: Spider-Man In Gokuldham (18th Anniversary)
description: Spider-Man visits Gokuldham Society to celebrate 18 glorious years of Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah with all residents.
